strangest.linePrev: And brought to me thoughts of the ill-fated day
strangest.line: The temples were filled with the strangest of creatures
strangest.lineNext: One played it by ear on the banks of the sea
stanza: The temples were filled with the strangest of creatures
One played it by ear on the banks of the sea
That one was found but the others they went under
Oh, the tears which are shed, they won't come from me
